findings.finding: Forecasts were computed after the current retirement decision. They could request infrastructure but did not veto retirement when current service was safe and committed-only future stress was unsafe.
findings.repair: Compute the frozen H-year forecast before retirement approval; include forecast risk in the retirement trigger; test current-safe/future-unsafe case.

findings.finding: Epsilon ranking selected the least-bad value even when all tested grid cells violated common service/carbon boundaries.
findings.repair: Separate diagnostic ranking from admissible threshold; return no feasible threshold when common bounds fail.

findings.finding: Annual operation constraints were not exported for every year, weakening reproducible distinction between device, budget and infrastructure limits.
findings.repair: Export per-year operation inputs and generate co-binding-constraint diagnostics, feasibility tables, five-dimension recommendations and figures.

findings.finding: Paid terminal devices commissioning beyond 2060 omitted from terminal paid-construction value.
findings.repair: Include paid device queues in residual asset accounts and independently reconstruct from the exported queue. Add a regression counterexample.
